name: @foxschema/sql
description: Dialect knowledge for FoxSchema: SQL generation, schema compare, statement splitting, and type mapping. Pure, runtime-neutral, zero dependencies.
//: `private` is the guard, not a mistake: `exports` here points at TS source on purpose (the backend runs under tsx and the CLI's esbuild bundle both resolve this package through `exports` with no alias, so pointing it at ./dist would make development load stale build output). Publishing THIS folder would therefore ship raw .ts behind `exports`, with dist/ excluded because it is gitignored — an unusable package. The publishable tarball is staged by scripts/prepare-publish.mjs into npm-pack/, which strips `private`/`scripts` and repoints `exports` at ./dist. `private` makes `npm publish -w @foxschema/sql` fail loudly instead. (publishConfig.exports is not honoured by npm 10, which is why this is a staging script rather than a field.)
